channel.title: Seasoning The Seasons
channel.desc: The calmness of Seto Inland Sea, located in western Japan, will send your worries away. One thing that has been firmly supporting lives in this area is stone. In this episode, we travel to the coastal area of the Seto Inland Sea, where life involves around reliable yet warm stones.
